purpose: Collect the sources already in the knowledge base that bear on the concede-vs-disclose hypotheses. Not a systematic search.
queries: No new queries; sources taken from existing notes and the draft
inclusion_scope: Sources on LLM negotiation payoffs, agent information leakage and delegated-agent loyalty already recorded in the knowledge base.
exclusion_scope: Everything not already in the knowledge base, including the persuasion candidates in inbox.md.
known_limitations: No source is read in full
Publication dates are taken from arXiv identifiers (month only)
last_result_screened_or_stop_rule: All notes in papers/ and all sources in the 2026-10-24 draft were listed; nothing beyond them was screened.
